name: Scope 1 emissions
question: What were the site's direct (Scope 1) greenhouse gas emissions?
help: Filled from approved emission rows: fuel burnt on site, company vehicles, process and fugitive emissions.

name: Scope 2 emissions (location-based)
question: What were the site's indirect emissions from purchased energy, using grid-average factors?
help: Filled from approved electricity, heat and steam rows with location-based factors.

name: Scope 2 emissions (market-based)
question: What were the site's indirect emissions from purchased energy, using supplier and contract factors?
help: Filled from approved electricity, heat and steam rows with market-based factors (green tariffs, certificates).

name: Scope 3 emissions
question: What were the value-chain (Scope 3) emissions?
help: Filled from approved Scope 3 rows across the categories in the company's boundary.

name: GHG intensity per revenue
question: How much Scope 1 and 2 emissions did the company emit per crore of revenue?
help: Calculated: (Scope 1 + Scope 2 location-based) divided by revenue.

name: Energy consumed
question: How much energy did the site use in total?
help: Filled from approved fuel and electricity rows: fuels burnt, electricity, heat, steam and cooling bought, and self-generated renewable energy used.

name: Renewable energy consumed
question: How much of the site's energy came from renewable sources?
help: Filled from approved rows for renewable electricity (own solar, green tariffs, certificates) and renewable fuels such as biomass.

name: Non-renewable energy consumed
question: How much of the site's energy came from fossil or other non-renewable sources?
help: Filled from approved rows for fossil fuels and grid electricity that isn't backed by renewable certificates.

name: Energy intensity per revenue
question: How much energy did the company use per crore of revenue?
help: Calculated: total energy consumed divided by revenue.

name: Share of renewable energy
question: What share of the energy used came from renewable sources?
help: Calculated: renewable energy divided by total energy, as a percentage.

name: Water withdrawn
question: How much water did the site take in?
help: What counts: municipal supply, borewells, rivers or lakes, tankers, rainwater stored and used. Not: water recycled on site.

name: Water discharged
question: How much water left the site as effluent or discharge?
help: What counts: treated or untreated water sent to sewers, rivers, the sea, groundwater or another company. Not: water that evaporated or went into products.

name: Water consumed
question: How much water did the site use up (withdrawn minus discharged)?
help: Calculated: water withdrawn minus water discharged.

name: Water intensity per revenue
question: How much water did the company consume per crore of revenue?
help: Calculated: water consumed divided by revenue.

name: Water recycled and reused
question: How much water did the site treat and use again?
help: What counts: water reused in processes, cooling or gardening after on-site treatment.

name: Waste generated
question: How much waste did the site produce?
help: What counts: all solid and liquid waste leaving the site, hazardous and non-hazardous. Split it by type when asked for BRSR.

name: Hazardous waste generated
question: How much of the site's waste was hazardous?
help: What counts: waste classed as hazardous under local law, such as used oil, chemicals, e-waste and bio-medical waste.

name: Waste recovered
question: How much waste was sent for recycling, reuse or other recovery?
help: What counts: waste recycled, prepared for reuse or otherwise recovered, by you or a contractor.

name: Waste disposed
question: How much waste was incinerated, landfilled or otherwise disposed of?
help: What counts: waste incinerated (with or without energy recovery), sent to landfill or otherwise disposed of.

name: Waste intensity per revenue
question: How much waste did the company generate per crore of revenue?
help: Calculated: waste generated divided by revenue.

name: NOx emissions
question: How many tonnes of nitrogen oxides (NOx) did the site emit to air?
help: From stack monitoring or calculations in your consent-to-operate reports.

name: SOx emissions
question: How many tonnes of sulphur oxides (SOx) did the site emit to air?
help: From stack monitoring or calculations in your consent-to-operate reports.

name: Particulate matter emissions
question: How many tonnes of particulate matter (PM) did the site emit to air?
help: From stack monitoring or calculations in your consent-to-operate reports.

name: Revenue
question: What was the company's revenue from operations for the year?
help: Use the audited figure from the financial statements (revenue from operations). Used to work out intensities.

name: Hours worked
question: How many hours did employees and workers work at the site?
help: Total person-hours worked, including overtime. Used to work out injury rates.

name: Employees
question: How many employees did the company have at the end of the year?
help: Headcount at year end, everyone on the payroll. Split by gender.

name: Permanent employees
question: How many permanent employees did the company have at the end of the year?
help: Headcount at year end of employees on permanent contracts. Split by gender.

name: Temporary employees
question: How many employees on fixed-term or temporary contracts did the company have at the end of the year?
help: Headcount at year end of employees who are not permanent. Split by gender.

name: Workers who are not employees
question: How many workers who aren't employees (contract labour, agency staff) worked for the company at the end of the year?
help: Headcount at year end of people whose work you control but who are employed by someone else.

name: Employees with disabilities
question: How many employees with disabilities did the company have at the end of the year?
help: Headcount at year end of employees with a disability, as recorded under local law.

name: New hires
question: How many new employees joined during the year?
help: Everyone who joined the payroll during the year. Split by gender.

name: Employees who left
question: How many employees left during the year?
help: Everyone who left for any reason: resignation, dismissal, retirement or death.

name: Employee turnover rate
question: What share of permanent employees left during the year?
help: Employees who left divided by the average number of permanent employees, as a percentage.

name: Return to work after parental leave
question: What share of employees who took parental leave came back to work?
help: Employees who returned after their leave ended divided by those due to return, as a percentage.

name: Spending on employee well-being
question: How much did the company spend on employee and worker well-being, as a share of revenue?
help: Health and accident insurance, maternity and paternity benefits, day care and similar measures, divided by revenue.

name: Lost-time injuries
question: How many work injuries at the site led to time off work?
help: Count each injury where the person couldn't work the next scheduled shift.

name: Lost-time injury frequency rate
question: What was the site's lost-time injury frequency rate (per million hours worked)?
help: Lost-time injuries times one million, divided by hours worked.

name: Recordable work-related injuries
question: How many recordable work-related injuries happened at the site?
help: Injuries needing more than first aid: medical treatment, restricted work, time off, or worse.

name: High-consequence injuries
question: How many work injuries at the site were so serious the person couldn't fully recover within six months?
help: Life-changing injuries, not counting deaths.

name: Fatalities
question: How many people died as a result of work-related injury or ill health at the site?
help: Count employees and workers who aren't employees.

name: Days lost to injury and ill health
question: How many working days were lost to work-related injuries, ill health and deaths?
help: Calendar days the people affected couldn't work, from the day after the incident.

name: Complaints on working conditions and safety
question: How many complaints about working conditions or health and safety did the company receive?
help: Count complaints from employees and workers through any channel.

name: Training hours per employee
question: How many hours of training did an employee get on average?
help: Total training hours divided by employees at year end.

name: Employees trained on health and safety
question: What share of employees were trained on health and safety during the year?
help: Employees who completed at least one health and safety training, as a percentage of all employees.

name: Employees with performance reviews
question: What share of employees had a performance and career development review during the year?
help: Employees with a documented review, as a percentage of all employees.

name: Employees trained on human rights
question: What share of employees were trained on human rights issues and policies?
help: Employees who completed human rights training, as a percentage of all employees.

name: Women in the workforce
question: What share of employees are women?
help: Women employees at year end divided by all employees, as a percentage.

name: Women on the board
question: What share of board members are women?
help: Women directors at year end divided by all directors, as a percentage.

name: Women in top management
question: What share of top management (key managerial personnel) are women?
help: Women in the top management level at year end divided by everyone at that level, as a percentage.

name: Employees by age group
question: How many employees were in each age group at the end of the year?
help: Headcount at year end split into under 30, 30 to 50, and over 50.

name: Gender pay gap
question: By what percentage is women's average pay lower than men's?
help: (Men's average gross hourly pay minus women's) divided by men's, as a percentage. Negative when women earn more.

name: Wages paid to women
question: What share of total gross wages was paid to women?
help: Gross wages paid to women divided by total gross wages, as a percentage.

name: Median pay of employees
question: What was the median annual pay of employees?
help: The middle value of annual gross pay across employees (not directors or key managerial personnel).

name: Highest pay to median pay ratio
question: How many times the median employee's pay did the highest-paid person earn?
help: Annual total pay of the highest-paid individual divided by the median of everyone else.

name: Employees paid at least minimum wage
question: What share of employees were paid at least the minimum wage?
help: Employees paid equal to or more than the applicable minimum wage, as a percentage.

name: Human rights complaints received
question: How many complaints about discrimination, harassment, child or forced labour, wages or other human rights did the company receive?
help: Count every complaint filed during the year, through any channel.

name: Human rights complaints resolved
question: How many of those complaints were resolved by the end of the year?
help: Count complaints closed with an outcome during the year.

name: Sexual harassment complaints
question: How many sexual harassment complaints were filed under the workplace sexual harassment law?
help: Complaints received by the internal committee during the year.

name: Independent directors on the board
question: What share of board members are independent directors?
help: Independent directors at year end divided by all directors, as a percentage. Count a director as independent when they meet the test in your company law or listing rules.

name: Confirmed incidents of corruption
question: How many incidents of corruption or bribery were confirmed during the year?
help: Count incidents found to be true during the year, involving the company or its employees. Allegations still under investigation don't count yet.

name: Employees trained on anti-corruption
question: What share of employees were trained on anti-corruption during the year?
help: Employees who completed anti-corruption or anti-bribery training during the year, as a percentage of all employees at year end.

name: Fines and penalties paid
question: How much did the company pay in fines, penalties and settlements to regulators, enforcement agencies and courts during the year?
help: Total paid during the year by the company or its directors and key managerial personnel, in INR (the currency of the financial statements; convert any other currency at the rate used there). Split out fines under anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws.

name: Ethics and whistle-blower concerns raised
question: How many concerns about business conduct (whistle-blower reports, ethics complaints) were raised during the year?
help: Count every concern received through the whistle-blower, ethics or speak-up channels, whatever its outcome.

name: Days to pay suppliers
question: On average, how many days does the company take to pay its suppliers?
help: Accounts payable at year end × 365, divided by the cost of goods and services bought during the year, both from the financial statements.

name: Data breaches
question: How many data breaches or cyber security incidents did the company have during the year?
help: Count each breach once. Split out the breaches that involved customers' personal data.
